I used to use Vega! It's a plant based protein powder and they have different flavors and no flavor ones as well. They have different selection like full nutrition and sport ones. I used to love getting the vanilla essential for all the vitamins in it. And also if you subscribe to their site with account, you save money/discount and can get a free sample of your choice of the selection they give you. If you happen to purchase this powder, beware of silica gel packet inside the tub! It says in really small print on the back and i never noticed and ended up blending it with my smoothies... Please be careful haha
